chunks.arabic_text: وَسَأَلَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ:

translations.en: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr asked al-Ridha عليه السلام:

chunks.arabic_text: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَتَزَوَّجُ الْمَرْأَةَ مُتْعَةً أَيَحِلُّ لَهُ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَ ابْنَتَهَا بَتَاتًا

translations.en: about a man who marries a woman in mut'ah: is it permissible for him to marry her daughter permanently?

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning temporary marriage and its effect on marital prohibitions. Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام states that a man who has married a woman in mut'ah may not then marry her daughter permanently, indicating that this relationship establishes a prohibition in marriage.
en.seo_question: Can a man marry the daughter of a woman he married in mut'ah?

key_terms.بَتَاتًا: permanently, not as a temporary marriage

result.diacritized_text: وَسَأَلَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَتَزَوَّجُ الْمَرْأَةَ مُتْعَةً أَيَحِلُّ لَهُ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَ ابْنَتَهَا بَتَاتًا قَالَ «لَا».
